pr_title: ES|QL: Perform a final cleanup of the optimizer rules tests
pr_body:
This PR cleans up the optimization rules tests by:
- creating a new test class for `PushDownAndCombineFilters` rule and moving there the tests that specifically call this rule
- removing duplicated tests for `FoldNull` and `PropagateNullables` rules; moving specific tests to their own classes
- using the already existent utils methods in `EsqlTestUtils` and removing the duplicated ones from `LogicalPlanOptimizerTests`

Closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/109215
pr_comments:
Thanks @alex-spies!

> I think the non-local *OptimizerTests classes are still huge (6k lines on the logical one, 5k on the physical); ideally, these would also be split apart wherever tests belong mostly to specific optimizer rules, like testPruneMixedAggInsideUnusedEval which tests PruneColumns (in the context of the whole optimizer).

That's way more work than just creating individual test files for individual rules and move the obvious ones there. Some (many?, not sure) of those tests rely on more than one rule. This needs a fairly deep knowledge of those specific tests to be able to (to a point) find the right *Test file.

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/109215 has some good intentions based on the advantages one gets from finding specific rules tests in specific files when working on that rule, but I want to point out another aspect that, **for me personally**, is more useful when it comes to a larger-class having a bigger number of tests in: more easily finding (and reusing) utils methods that one might not know about and, also, more easily skimming through examples of queries to take inspiration from.

> I think it's fine to call it a day on https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/109215 though as long as we try to get the structure of the tests closer to the structure of the optimizer rules as we work on them.

Strongly agree on this one. With time, and with a bit of discipline and willingness, I think we can clean up further the tests and put them in more individual test files as we work in that area.

issue_context.title: Refactor ESQL optimizer rules
issue_context.body:
Split the `OptimizerRules` class and associated tests into individual top level classes and single-class test files.

Right now, the `OptimizerRules` class is over 1000 lines long, and has another 1000+ lines in core, and all it does is wrap many small static classes.  Those should all be pulled up to the top level, and have individual test files, so it's clearer what our coverage gaps are.
comments: Hey can I work on this?

I think this is complete with [PR1](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/112338), [PR2](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/112589), [PR3](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/110654), [PR4](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/110728), [PR5](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/109644) (and maybe others) merged.

Other work that is related, but far more involved than the regular approachable refactoring, is captured in [this comment](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/112589#issuecomment-2338226178) about moving the majority of the remaining test methods in individual files with time and when working on specific areas. This work requires much more targeted knowledge about optimization rules and which tests are related more to a specific rule than others.

review_comments: The testGenericNullableExpression variant from LogicalPlanOptimizerTests was more extensive, thus the additional lines here.
